annexure: Annexure A - Accreditation Framework & OBE Standards

programOutcomes.title: Engineering Knowledge
programOutcomes.description: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

programOutcomes.title: Problem Analysis
programOutcomes.description: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.

programOutcomes.title: Design/Development of Solutions
programOutcomes.description: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, and cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.

programOutcomes.title: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems
programOutcomes.description: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.

programOutcomes.title: Modern Tool Usage
programOutcomes.description: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.

programOutcomes.title: The Engineer and Society
programOutcomes.description: Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.

programOutcomes.title: Environment and Sustainability
programOutcomes.description: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.

programOutcomes.title: Ethics
programOutcomes.description: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.

programOutcomes.title: Individual and Team Work
programOutcomes.description: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.

programOutcomes.title: Communication
programOutcomes.description: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.

programOutcomes.title: Project Management and Finance
programOutcomes.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

programOutcomes.title: Life-long Learning
programOutcomes.description: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Core Technical & Algorithmic Competency
programSpecificOutcomes.description: Design, develop, and analyze algorithmic computations, data architectures, and software systems to solve real-world engineering challenges efficiently.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Modern Software & Platform Engineering
programSpecificOutcomes.description: Build robust, secure, and distributed software systems applying contemporary full-stack, cloud architectures, and modern DevOps/CI tool pipelines.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Intelligent Systems & Applied AI/ML
programSpecificOutcomes.description: Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data analytics principles to synthesize unstructured data and develop intelligent automated solutions.

bloomsLevels.name: Remember
bloomsLevels.description: Exhibit memory of previously learned materials by recalling facts, terms, basic concepts, and answers.

bloomsLevels.name: Understand
bloomsLevels.description: Demonstrate understanding of facts and ideas by organizing, comparing, translating, interpreting, giving descriptions, and stating main ideas.

bloomsLevels.name: Apply
bloomsLevels.description: Solve problems to new situations by applying acquired knowledge, facts, techniques and rules in a different way.

bloomsLevels.name: Analyze
bloomsLevels.description: Examine and break information into parts by identifying motives or causes; make inferences and find evidence to support generalizations.

bloomsLevels.name: Evaluate
bloomsLevels.description: Present and defend opinions by making judgments about information, validity of ideas, or quality of work based on a set of criteria.

bloomsLevels.name: Create
bloomsLevels.description: Compile information together in a different way by combining elements in a new pattern or proposing alternative solutions.

correlationScale.label: No Correlation
correlationScale.description: The course outcome does not substantially contribute to this program outcome.

correlationScale.label: Low / Slight
correlationScale.description: CLO addresses the PO peripherally (up to 30% emphasis in syllabus and evaluation).

correlationScale.label: Medium / Moderate
correlationScale.description: CLO addresses the PO moderately (30% to 60% emphasis in syllabus and evaluation).

correlationScale.label: High / Substantial
correlationScale.description: CLO directly and substantially delivers and measures this PO (>60% emphasis in syllabus and evaluation).
